about: Hand-made mappings for the gf180mcuD gap table (GAPS-gf180mcuD 1). Keys are the KLayout deck's rule IDs without the _LV/_MV suffix; Magic's older numbers are mapped onto them by ID (ids) or line by line (lines).

PP.8a.note: Magic checks the PPLUS it generates (tech:1407-1420), KLayout the drawn PPLUS (GAPS-gf180mcuD 1)

NP.8a.note: Magic checks the NPLUS it generates (tech:1407-1420), KLayout the drawn NPLUS (GAPS-gf180mcuD 1)

CO.3.note: Magic grows each contact by 0.005 µm per side when it reads it (a 0.22 µm cut becomes a 0.23 µm contact area, GAPS-gf180mcuD 1), so its 0.065 µm is 0.07 µm from the cut

CO.4.note: Magic grows each contact by 0.005 µm per side when it reads it (a 0.22 µm cut becomes a 0.23 µm contact area, GAPS-gf180mcuD 1), so its 0.065 µm is 0.07 µm from the cut

CO.6.note: Magic's directional overlap (tech:2885, 2906) is 0.055 µm from its contact area, 0.06 µm from the cut, as KLayout's CO.6a; both decks agreed on the two CO.6 cases (GAPS-gf180mcuD 1)

MIMTM.5.note: Magic 0.39, KLayout 0.4; Magic measures to its via4 area, and if that area is the cut plus 0.01 µm per side, as tech:3053's V4.1 + 2 * V4.4 implies, its 0.39 µm is 0.4 µm from the cut (not measured)

S.CO.4.note: Magic grows each contact by 0.005 µm per side when it reads it (GAPS-gf180mcuD 1), so its two SRAM checks of COMP overlap of contact, 0.035 µm (tech:2923-2930), are 0.04 µm from the cut: equal to KLayout's S.CO.4_MV, and 0.01 µm more than its S.CO.4_LV 0.03 µm for the 3.3 V SRAM, which Magic prints as S.CO.3_LV
